title: Psalm 29
opening_line: Give ye unto the LORD, ye sons

source.note: Received text from the official Free Church digital edition and plain-text archive.

text.diplomatic: Give ye unto the LORD, ye sons
text.normalized: Give ye unto the LORD, ye sons
text.reading: Give ye unto the LORD, ye sons

text.diplomatic: that of the mighty be,
text.normalized: That of the mighty be,
text.reading: that of the mighty be,

text.diplomatic: All strength and glory to the LORD
text.normalized: All strength and glory to the LORD
text.reading: All strength and glory to the LORD

text.diplomatic: with cheerfulness give ye.
text.normalized: With cheerfulness give ye.
text.reading: with cheerfulness give ye.

text.diplomatic: Unto the LORD the glory give
text.normalized: Unto the LORD the glory give
text.reading: Unto the LORD the glory give

text.diplomatic: that to his name is due;
text.normalized: That to his name is due;
text.reading: that to his name is due;

text.diplomatic: And in the beauty of holiness
text.normalized: And in the beauty of holiness
text.reading: And in the beauty of holiness

text.diplomatic: unto JEHOVAH bow.
text.normalized: Unto JEHOVAH bow.
text.reading: unto JEHOVAH bow.

text.diplomatic: The LORD’s voice on the waters is;
text.normalized: The LORD’s voice on the waters is;
text.reading: The LORD’s voice on the waters is;

text.diplomatic: the God of majesty
text.normalized: The God of majesty
text.reading: the God of majesty

text.diplomatic: Doth thunder, and on multitudes
text.normalized: Doth thunder, and on multitudes
text.reading: Doth thunder, and on multitudes

text.diplomatic: of waters sitteth he.
text.normalized: Of waters sitteth he.
text.reading: of waters sitteth he.

text.diplomatic: A pow’rful voice it is that comes
text.normalized: A pow’rful voice it is that comes
text.reading: A pow’rful voice it is that comes

text.diplomatic: out from the LORD most high;
text.normalized: Out from the LORD most high;
text.reading: out from the LORD most high;

text.diplomatic: The voice of that great LORD is full
text.normalized: The voice of that great LORD is full
text.reading: The voice of that great LORD is full

text.diplomatic: of glorious majesty.
text.normalized: Of glorious majesty.
text.reading: of glorious majesty.

text.diplomatic: The voice of the ETERNAL doth
text.normalized: The voice of the ETERNAL doth
text.reading: The voice of the ETERNAL doth

text.diplomatic: asunder cedars tear;
text.normalized: Asunder cedars tear;
text.reading: asunder cedars tear;

text.diplomatic: Yea, God the LORD doth cedars break
text.normalized: Yea, God the LORD doth cedars break
text.reading: Yea, God the LORD doth cedars break

text.diplomatic: that Lebanon doth bear.
text.normalized: That Lebanon doth bear.
text.reading: that Lebanon doth bear.

text.diplomatic: He makes them like a calf to skip,
text.normalized: He makes them like a calf to skip,
text.reading: He makes them like a calf to skip,

text.diplomatic: ev’n that great Lebanon,
text.normalized: Ev’n that great Lebanon,
text.reading: ev’n that great Lebanon,

text.diplomatic: And, like to a young unicorn,
text.normalized: And, like to a young unicorn,
text.reading: And, like to a young unicorn,

text.diplomatic: the mountain Sirion.
text.normalized: The mountain Sirion.
text.reading: the mountain Sirion.

text.diplomatic: God’s voice divides the flames of fire;
text.normalized: God’s voice divides the flames of fire;
text.reading: God’s voice divides the flames of fire;

text.diplomatic: the desert it doth shake:
text.normalized: The desert it doth shake:
text.reading: the desert it doth shake:

text.diplomatic: The LORD doth make the wilderness
text.normalized: The LORD doth make the wilderness
text.reading: The LORD doth make the wilderness

text.diplomatic: of Kadesh all to quake.
text.normalized: Of Kadesh all to quake.
text.reading: of Kadesh all to quake.

text.diplomatic: GOD’s voice doth make the hinds to calve,
text.normalized: GOD’s voice doth make the hinds to calve,
text.reading: GOD’s voice doth make the hinds to calve,

text.diplomatic: it makes the forest bare:
text.normalized: It makes the forest bare:
text.reading: it makes the forest bare:

text.diplomatic: And in his temple everyone
text.normalized: And in his temple everyone
text.reading: And in his temple everyone

text.diplomatic: his glory doth declare.
text.normalized: His glory doth declare.
text.reading: his glory doth declare.

text.diplomatic: The LORD sits on the floods; the LORD
text.normalized: The LORD sits on the floods; the LORD
text.reading: The LORD sits on the floods; the LORD

text.diplomatic: sits King, and ever shall.
text.normalized: Sits King, and ever shall.
text.reading: sits King, and ever shall.

text.diplomatic: The LORD will give his people strength,
text.normalized: The LORD will give his people strength,
text.reading: The LORD will give his people strength,

text.diplomatic: and with peace bless them all.
text.normalized: And with peace bless them all.
